	set psw_black6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval,timeout
		auto-merge
		timeout 2d
		gc-interval 1h
	}

	set psw_black6_static {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
		elements = { 2001:67c:4e8::/48,
			     2001:b28:f23c::/47,
			     2001:b28:f23f::/48,
			     2001:b28:f242::/48 }
	}

	set psw_white6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval,timeout
		auto-merge
		timeout 2d
		gc-interval 1h
	}

	set psw_white6_static {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
	}

	set psw_block6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval,timeout
		auto-merge
		timeout 2d
		gc-interval 1h
	}

	set psw_block6_static {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
	}

	set psw_shunt6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval,timeout
		auto-merge
		timeout 2d
		gc-interval 1h
	}

	set psw_shunt6_static {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
	}

	chain dstnat {
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat - 1; policy accept;
		ip6 saddr @psw_lan6 jump PSW_DNS
		ip saddr @psw_lan jump PSW_DNS
		ip protocol tcp counter packets 7 bytes 420 jump PSW_NAT
	}

	chain mangle_prerouting {
		type filter hook prerouting priority mangle - 1; policy accept;
		counter packets 289 bytes 53833 jump PSW_DIVERT
		ip protocol udp counter packets 46 bytes 9756 jump PSW_MANGLE
	}

	chain mangle_output {
		type route hook output priority mangle - 1; policy accept;
		meta skgid 9911 counter packets 0 bytes 0 return comment "PSW_DIRECT"
		ip protocol udp counter packets 48 bytes 10623 jump PSW_OUTPUT_MANGLE comment "PSW_OUTPUT_MANGLE"
		oif "lo" counter packets 116 bytes 14489 return comment "PSW_OUTPUT_MANGLE"
		meta mark 0x50535731 counter packets 3 bytes 228 return comment "PSW_OUTPUT_MANGLE"
	}

	chain nat_output {
		type nat hook output priority filter - 1; policy accept;
		meta skgid 9911 counter packets 0 bytes 0 return comment "PSW_DIRECT"
		oif "lo" udp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 redirect to :11400 comment "PSW_DNS"
		oif "lo" tcp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 redirect to :11400 comment "PSW_DNS"
		ip protocol tcp counter packets 12 bytes 720 jump PSW_OUTPUT_NAT
	}

	chain PSW_DIVERT {
		meta l4proto tcp socket transparent 1 meta mark set 0x50535731 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept
	}

	chain PSW_DNS {
		udp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 redirect to :11400 comment "默认"
		tcp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 redirect to :11400 comment "默认"
	}

	chain PSW_RULE {
		counter packets 3 bytes 228 meta mark set ct mark
		meta mark 0x50535731 counter packets 0 bytes 0 return
		tcp flags & (fin | syn | rst | ack) == syn counter packets 0 bytes 0 meta mark set 0x50535731
		meta l4proto udp ct state { related, new } counter packets 3 bytes 228 meta mark set 0x50535731
		counter packets 3 bytes 228 ct mark set meta mark
	}

	chain PSW_MANGLE {
		ip daddr @psw_lan counter packets 43 bytes 9528 return
		ip daddr @psw_vps counter packets 0 bytes 0 return
		ct direction reply counter packets 0 bytes 0 return
		ip daddr @psw_wan counter packets 0 bytes 0 return comment "WAN_IP_RETURN"
		ip protocol udp iif "lo" counter packets 3 bytes 228 meta mark 0x50535731 tproxy ip to :1041 comment "本机"
		ip protocol udp iif "lo" counter packets 3 bytes 228 return comment "本机"
		ip protocol udp udp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 return comment "默认"
		ip protocol tcp tcp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 return comment "默认"
		ip daddr @psw_block counter packets 0 bytes 0 reject with icmp port-unreachable comment "默认"
		ip daddr @psw_block_static counter packets 0 bytes 0 reject with icmp port-unreachable comment "默认"
		ip daddr @psw_white counter packets 0 bytes 0 return comment "默认"
